'''Smooth Stone''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] replaces its vanilla recipe with a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Smooth Stone Slab}}) and a [[Mud Kiln]] recipe (from [[Limestone]]). See {{MCW|Smooth Stone}} for everything else.
